# User

------------ | ------------- | ------------- | -------------
**Email** | **string** | Lowercase email address for the user. Use this for display and invitation matching, not as a stable identifier. |

**Name** | **string** | Display name of the user. |

**CustomRoleId** | Pointer to **string** | Identifier of the custom role held by the user, when &#x60;role&#x60; is &#x60;custom&#x60;. Use it with the custom role endpoints to read what the role grants. | [optional]
